summary: This is a composer.json file that configures a PHP project called 'johndoe/behat' for behavior-driven testing. It sets up autoloading so that code in the src/ folder can be accessed as Johndoe\Behat classes, and it declares all the testing libraries the project needs during development, including Behat and browser automation tools.

explanations.6: PSR-4 is a PHP standard that tells composer how to automatically find and load classes based on their namespace — so a class named Johndoe\Behat\Something will be looked for in src/Something.php.
explanations.15: require-dev means these packages are only needed when developing or testing the project, not when running it in production.
explanations.16: The ^3 means 'version 3 or any newer version up to (but not including) version 4' — this gives flexibility while ensuring major breaking changes don't sneak in.
